import json, os, subprocess, sys, random
rng = random.Random(99)
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from fuzz import rand_topology, rand_settings, gen_events
cases = []
for i in range(6):
    topo = rand_topology(rng); st = rand_settings(rng); ev = gen_events(rng, topo, st, 10)
    cases.append({'topology': topo, 'settings': st, 'events': ev})
payload = json.dumps({'streams': cases}, separators=(',', ':'))
outs = set()
for seed in ('0', '1', '12345', 'random'):
    env = dict(os.environ); env['PYTHONHASHSEED'] = seed
    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-B', '-u', 'submission/main.py'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                         stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd='/workspace', env=env)
    out, err = p.communicate(payload.encode())
    assert p.returncode == 0 and not err, (p.returncode, err[:400])
    outs.add(out)
print('distinct outputs across hash seeds:', len(outs))
assert len(outs) == 1
# also repeated in-process runs
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
